name: week
title: Agency weekly review
subtitle: A read-only snapshot. Regenerate after changing records.

sections.title: Decisions needed
sections.sql: select * from attention order by code

sections.title: Margin forecast
sections.note: Agreed fees less recorded costs and estimated remaining task costs. Excludes overhead and tax.
sections.sql: select code,currency,agreed_fee,forecast_cost,forecast_contribution from project_health order by code

sections.title: Capacity after leave
sections.sql: select * from capacity where week_on>=date_trunc('week',current_date)::date order by week_on,name

sections.title: Period usage
sections.note: Each retainer period is a separate project. Unused time does not roll forward automatically.
sections.sql: select code,start_on,due_on,budget_minutes,logged_minutes,greatest(0,logged_minutes-budget_minutes) overage_minutes from project_health where kind='retainer' order by due_on
